summary.short_summary: Founded in 2018 by Manu Verma, the e-commerce marketing agency specializes in Shopify development and marketing, serving primarily Australian clients. It operates with a small team, including one local account manager and several offshore contractors, emphasizing strong client retention through a retainer-based revenue model, contributing 95% of its income. The agency is generating AUD 100-110K monthly, projecting annual revenue of AUD 1.2 million and an EBITDA estimate of AUD 750K. Manu is open to acquisition opportunities, aiming for a valuation of 5x the last 12 months' EBITDA, with a preferred deal structure of 50% upfront and 50% earnout, reflecting a flexible approach to post-acquisition involvement.
